name: @taika-st/ref-tools-mcp-optimized

tools.name: ref_search_documentation
tools.description:
Search for documentation on the web or github as well from private resources like repos and pdfs.

  🎯 OPTIMIZATION FORMULA: "{api_name} {feature} {context} {action}"

  ✅ GOOD Examples:
  - "createMCPClient experimental MCP tools integration"
  - "AI SDK Model Context Protocol Bedrock provider setup"  
  - "streamText onFinish callback MCP client close"
  - "Next.js middleware JWT authentication setup"

  ❌ AVOID:
  - "Vercel documentation" (too generic)
  - "How to use React" (natural language)
  - "AI SDK help" (vague)

  💡 KEY TIPS:
  - Use exact API function names (createMCPClient, streamText, generateText)
  - Include status words (experimental, stable, deprecated)
  - Combine technologies (MCP Bedrock, SSE transport, stdio client)
  - Target specific actions (setup, integration, configuration, close)

  Use Ref 'ref_read_url' to read the content of a url.

query.description: Query for documentation using the optimization formula above. Should include programming language and framework or library names. Searches public only docs by default, include ref_src=private to search a user's private docs.

tools.name: ref_read_url
tools.description:
Read the content of a url as markdown. The entire exact URL from a Ref 'ref_search_documentation' result should be passed to this tool to read it.

  💡 TIP: Use this after getting search results to read the full documentation page content.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to read.

stderr: Ref MCP Server running on stdio
